name: rc_aarhus
title: File:Aarhus skyline with Domkirke cathedral spire at night from harbour 01.jpg
author: Ciara Ní Riain
description: Aarhus, Denmark, skyline at sunset, a freezing February afternoon. The sky and sea are empty and deep blue. They fill the scene above and below. Slicing thinly across the middle: the city skyline in dark silhouette with a glow of sunset orange just behind. Warm yellow lights glow from some building windows. We see a slim row of historic and modern buildings that jut up and down at different height
